lines.hanzi: 我住在大城市，生活很方便。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zhù zài dà chéngshì, shēnghuó hěn fāngbiàn.
lines.english: I live in a big city, life is very convenient.

lines.hanzi: 家附近有超市、医院、银行、公园。
lines.pinyin: Jiā fùjìn yǒu chāoshì, yīyuàn, yínháng, gōngyuán.
lines.english: Near home there are supermarkets, hospitals, banks, parks.

lines.hanzi: 出门坐地铁，去哪儿都很快。
lines.pinyin: Chūmén zuò dìtiě, qù nǎr dōu hěn kuài.
lines.english: Go out take subway, go anywhere very fast.

lines.hanzi: 城市里饭馆很多，什么菜都有。
lines.pinyin: Chéngshì lǐ fànguǎn hěn duō, shénme cài dōu yǒu.
lines.english: In the city there are many restaurants, all kinds of dishes.

lines.hanzi: 但是城市也有缺点。空气不如乡村好。
lines.pinyin: Dànshì chéngshì yě yǒu quēdiǎn. Kōngqì bùrú xiāngcūn hǎo.
lines.english: But the city also has shortcomings. Air not as good as countryside.

lines.hanzi: 车太多，早晚高峰很堵车。
lines.pinyin: Chē tài duō, zǎowǎn gāofēng hěn dǔchē.
lines.english: Too many cars, rush hour very jammed.

lines.hanzi: 房子很贵，很多人买不起房。
lines.pinyin: Fángzi hěn guì, hěn duō rén mǎi bu qǐ fáng.
lines.english: Houses very expensive, many people can't afford to buy.

lines.hanzi: 生活节奏快，压力大，容易累。
lines.pinyin: Shēnghuó jiézòu kuài, yālì dà, róngyì lèi.
lines.english: Life pace fast, pressure big, easy to get tired.

lines.hanzi: 不过我还是喜欢城市，机会多。
lines.pinyin: Bùguò wǒ háishì xǐhuan chéngshì, jīhuì duō.
lines.english: But I still like the city, more opportunities.

lines.hanzi: 周末我常去公园散步，放松一下。
lines.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ cháng qù gōngyuán sànbù, fàngsōng yīxià.
lines.english: Weekends I often go to the park for a walk, relax a bit.
